links.outcome: LLM ability to choose safe medications given contraindications and drug interactions in simulated consultations
links.effect: Current LLMs struggle to integrate contraindication and interaction knowledge, especially when risks are implied rather than explicit; no numeric results in the abstract.
links.quote: Results show that current LLMs struggle to integrate contraindication and interaction knowledge, especially when risks are implied rather than explicit.

unlisted_practices: Improving LLM medication safety through better prompting and task-specific tuning

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated benchmark (RxSafeBench) to evaluate large language model medication safety across simulated consultation scenarios.
